PLAN "Perimenopause Bone-Loading Strength (12 Weeks from 2026-06-01)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase bone density via heavy compound lifts and preserve lean mass"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation Strength" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower A - Squat Emphasis":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 6..7 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          calf_raise 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper A - Press Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x4..6 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 6..7 rest 150 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower B - Hinge Emphasis":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 5x3..5 rpe 6..7 rest 210 seconds
          front_squat 4x4..6 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Saturday training 45m "Upper B - Vertical Pull/Press":

          rowing 5m
